sentences.text:
DATED: 11.09.2019)
 ...RESPONDENTS  (BY SMT. MAYA.T.R, HCGP)
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-K:9577  WP No. 201620 of 2019  THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, PRAYING TO ISSUE A WRIT OR ORDER OR DIRECTION WRIT IN THE NATURE OF CERTIORARI, QUASHING THE NOTIFICATION DATED 28.06.2017.

ISSUED BY RESPONDENT UNDER SECTION 19 (1) OF THE NEW ACT,2013, VIDE ANNEXURE-D AND THE NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 19(2) OF THE NEW ACT,2013 DATED 30.01.2019 ISSUED BY RESPONDENT NO.2 ANNEXURE-E IN SO FAR AS THE LAND OF THE PETITIONER AT SY.NO.211/3 SITUATED AT TAMADADDI VILLAGE, TALIKOTI HOBLI, TQ- MUDDEBIHAL, DIST- VIJAYAPURA IS CONCERNED.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR)

In this petition, petitioner has sought for the following reliefs:-
"a) Issue a writ or order or direction writ int eh nature of Certiorari quashing the Notification dated:
28.06.2017.

Issued by Respondent No.2 under Section 19(1) of the New Act, 2013 vide Annexure-D and the Notification under Section 19(2) of the New Act, 2013 dated: 30.01.2019 issued by Respondent No.2 vide Annexure-E, in so far as the land of the petitioner at Sy No.211/3 situated at Tamdaddi Village, Talikoti Hobli, Tq:
Muddebihal, Dist: Vijayapura is concerned.
b) Issue a writ or order or direction writ in the nature of Mandamus, directing the respondent No.2 to issue fresh Notification, by including the existence of well and structures as mentioned in Award Sri Nanagouda Biradar vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37691585/
2 dated: 05.03.2016, vide NC: 2024:KHC-K:9577 Annexure-B, by considering the representation dated:
07.03.2019, vide Annexure-G and G1respectively.

sentences.text:
c) Pass such any other orders as deemed fit by this Hon'ble Court under the facts and circumstances of the case in the interest of justice and equity."
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP for the respondents and perused the material on record.
3. When the matter was posted before this Court on 13.08.2024, the respondents - State sought for time to produce the award said to have been passed by them.

Accordingly, on the last date of hearing, a memo is filed by the learned HCGP enclosing a copy of the award dated 19.09.2019 passed by the respondents during the pendency of the present petition which was filed by the petitioner earlier on 21.03.2019.

4. In the light of the aforesaid facts and circumstances and the undisputed fact that the respondents - State have passed the award on 19.09.2019 during the pendency of the present petition and when the matter was sub judice before this Court, I deem it just and appropriate to dispose of this petition reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to take recourse to such remedies as available in NC:
2024:KHC-K:9577 law including challenging the said award and by seeking enhancement of compensation in accordance with law.

5. Subject to the aforesaid directions and reserving the aforesaid liberty in favour of the petitioner,
petition stands disposed of.

Sd/-
(S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR) JUDGE Srl.
